UserProgress.title: UserProgress
UserProgress.description: Private per-user German A1 Certificate progress and synced dictionary bookmarks (PII-free).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the learner who owns this progress record.

masteredVocabIds.description: Mastered A1 core vocabulary item IDs (max 200).

lastActiveModuleId.description: Most recently studied A1 module ID for seamless cross-device resume.

lastActiveTab.description: Most recently used A1 workspace tab.

bestMockScore.description: Highest percentage score (0-100) achieved across A1 mock exams.

totalMockAttempts.description: Total number of completed A1 mock exams (0-1000).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when user progress was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest sync update.

ExamAttempt.title: ExamAttempt
ExamAttempt.description: Immutable completed German A1 mock exam or skill-section attempt record.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the learner who completed the attempt.

status.description: Terminal status; completed exam attempts cannot be mutated.

passed.description: True when score meets or exceeds the official Goethe A1 60% passing threshold.

sectionScores.description: Per-skill breakdown map with hoeren, lesen, schreiben, sprechen integer scores (0-25).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the attempt was submitted.

SearchedWord.title: SearchedWord
SearchedWord.description: Permanently stored searched German word with English and Hindi meanings and Devanagari pronunciation for cross-device revision.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the learner who searched this word.

word.description: Canonical German word or short phrase.

article.description: German gender article if noun (der, die, das, or empty).

hindiMeaning.description: Natural Hindi meaning in Devanagari script.

devanagariFull.description: Devanagari pronunciation guide for the German word.

searchCount.description: How many times the learner has searched or revised this word (1-10000).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the word was first searched.

lastSearchedAt.description: Server timestamp of the most recent search or revision.

/users/{userId}.description: Private per-learner A1 Certificate progress and synced dictionary bookmarks.

/users/{userId}/examAttempts/{attemptId}.description: Immutable completed A1 mock exam and practice attempts belonging to the parent user.

/users/{userId}/searchedWords/{wordId}.description: Permanent per-user dictionary search history with English & Hindi meanings synced across laptop and mobile.
